description: Verify that TCP sends a FIN on a CLOSE call in ESTABLISHED or CLOSE-WAIT (RFC 793 §3.2 p23 Terminology)
approach:
[Objective]
A CLOSE call from the user side starts the half-close: in ESTABLISHED → FIN-WAIT-1, in CLOSE-WAIT → LAST-ACK. Both transitions emit a FIN.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Phase 1: DUT in ESTABLISHED → user CLOSE → DUT emits FIN.
2. Phase 2: DUT in CLOSE-WAIT (after tester FIN) → user CLOSE → DUT emits FIN.

[Pass condition]
DUT emits FIN in both phases.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_timeout_phase1 — no DUT FIN from ESTABLISHED
• Fail_timeout_phase2 — no DUT FIN from CLOSE-WAIT

verdicts.Pass: DUT emitted FIN on CLOSE in both states — normal
